overview.title: Green contrast to the walled town
overview.p1: Tioute offers palms, irrigation and a slower village pace a short drive from Taroudant. It is the classic nature counterpoint after a morning on the ramparts and souks.
overview.p2: Visits are often arranged with a driver. Respect private gardens and ask before photographing people.
